name: openai/gpt-4.1-nano
description: GPT-4.1 nano is the fastest and smallest tier of OpenAI's GPT-4.1 series, released in April 2025 as a non-reasoning model with text and image input and text output. It keeps the 1M-token context window and the instruction-following and tool-calling focus of its siblings, and OpenAI points to low-latency tasks such as classification and autocompletion. Choose it for high-volume, simple workloads; GPT-4.1 mini or GPT-4.1 handle harder prompts better.
